option_relations.rationale: The option 'Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma' directly matches the leaf label 'Cutaneous Metastasis from Breast Carcinoma'.
The option 'Carcinoma erysipeloides (cutaneous metastasis from breast carcinoma)' directly matches the leaf label 'Carcinoma Erysipeloides'.
The option 'Telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma (TMBC)' directly matches the leaf label 'Telangiectatic Metastatic Breast Carcinoma (TMBC)'.
The option 'Carcinoma en cuirasse (a sclerodermiform variant of breast carcinoma metastasis)' is a subtype of 'Cutaneous Metastasis from Breast Carcinoma'.
